title: pr-comment config
description: ~/.config/pr-comment/config.yaml (XDG respected) plus config.d/*.yaml in lexical order. Invalid config exits 2 (config_invalid), naming the key. Drop-ins: maps merge, hook lists append, other lists replace. Precedence: flags, then repos.<id>, then environment (top-level scalars only), then config, then defaults.

forgectl_bin.description: A bare name resolved only against absolute PATH entries, or an absolute path.

forgectl_config.description: Passed to forgectl as --config=<path>; must not start with a dash; null: unset.

timeout.description: Budget per forgectl call, passed as --timeout.

name.description: Used for the default actor and {user}; null: the OS username.

human.description: Attribution line for a human: actor, or false to leave out the attribution line and its --- (only the marker remains).
human.default: Drafted with AI assistance · posted by {user} after review · {sha}

auto.description: Attribution line for an auto: actor; never false.
auto.default: Posted automatically under policy {policy} · no human review · {sha}

footer.description: Each template is one line of at most 512 characters, starts with an ASCII letter or {, and contains no character of category Cc or Cf (Cf is checked in code), no forgectl separator, and no <, backtick, [, ] or backslash. Placeholders (closed set, each allowed in either template): {user} (the actor's name for human:, me.name for auto:), {policy} (the actor's name for auto:, empty for human:), {sha}, {decision_id}, {tool_version}; literal braces are {{ and }}, a lone brace is invalid. {user}, {policy} and {decision_id} are written as code spans. The rendered line passes through mention neutralizing. The attribution line goes at the top of the body; the marker line is always appended as the last line.

policy.description: neutralize replaces every @ in untrusted text (code included), and every entity form of @, with the fullwidth U+FF20 unless its name is allowed; only applicable suggestions are exempt. allow turns the pass off.

allow.description: Names that pass through, without the @, compared in ASCII lowercase on the whole name; a team as org/team.

resolve_body_thread.description: When to resolve a published review body's discussion: non_blocking (after comment and approving reviews), never, or always (also after request-changes reviews).

allow_auto_approve.description: Let an auto: actor approve (with at least one --decision-id).

hook_env_deny.description: Extra environment variables removed from hook processes, in addition to forgectl's ambient token list.

repos.description: Per-repo overrides, keyed by repo id (matched case-insensitively against forgectl show's repo): footer, mentions, gitlab and allow_auto_approve. They merge over the global values; unset keys inherit.

duration.description: Seconds as a positive number, a string <number><unit> with unit ms, s, m, h or d (e.g. '30s'), or a bare number string meaning seconds; zero is refused.

cmd.description: Run through sh -c in its own process group.

async.description: Run detached under a watchdog that enforces its timeout.

with_text.description: Add each body's final text to the payload's bodies.

hook_entry_post.description: Cannot undo; failures are logged and warned, never fatal.

hook_entry_pre.description: Exit 0 continues; 13 escalates; any other non-zero exit or a timeout vetoes.
